summary.en: Walk with your guide from the Town Clock down to the water. You stop four times. At each stop your guide tells you one thing about rights and responsibilities in Canada, and then asks you about it.
summary.fr: Marchez avec votre guide de la tour de l'horloge jusqu'à l'eau. Vous faites quatre haltes. À chaque halte, votre guide vous apprend une chose sur les droits et les responsabilités au Canada, puis vous pose des questions dessus.

text.en: That is fine. The harbour will still be here. Come and find me when you are ready.
text.fr: C'est correct. Le port sera encore là. Venez me retrouver quand vous voudrez.

text.en: Take your time. Each stop on this walk is about rights and responsibilities in Canada. Your task on the screen says what to do now.
text.fr: Prenez votre temps. Chaque halte de cette promenade porte sur les droits et les responsabilités au Canada. Votre mission à l'écran indique ce qu'il faut faire maintenant.

text.en: A citizen of Canada may live and work in any part of the country, leave it freely and come back.
text.fr: Un citoyen du Canada peut vivre et travailler dans n'importe quelle partie du pays, le quitter librement et y revenir.

source.quote: Mobility Rights — Canadians can live and work anywhere they choose in Canada, enter and leave the country freely, and apply for a passport.

verification.evidence: The Charter attempts to summarize fundamental freedoms while also setting out additional rights. The most important of these include: Mobility Rights — Canadians can live and work anywhere they choose in Canada, enter and leave the country freely, and apply for a passport.

text.en: You walked the harbour with me, from the Town Clock to the market stall, down to Pier 21 and on to the tug at the water's edge. Four stops, and the walk is over.
text.fr: Vous avez parcouru le port avec moi, de la tour de l'horloge à l'étal de marché, puis jusqu'au quai 21 et au remorqueur au bord de l'eau. Quatre haltes, et la marche est terminée.

prompt.en: Meet your guide by the harbour
prompt.fr: Retrouvez votre guide au bord du port

text.en: Hello! I am your guide. Welcome to Halifax.
text.fr: Bonjour! Je suis votre guide. Bienvenue à Halifax.

text.en: In Canada, every right you have comes with something you should do.
text.fr: Au Canada, chaque droit que vous avez s'accompagne d'une chose à faire.

source.quote: In Canada, rights come with responsibilities.

verification.evidence: Citizenship Responsibilities In Canada, rights come with responsibilities. These include: … Voting in elections — The right to vote comes with a responsibility to vote in federal, provincial or territorial and local elections.

text.en: Millions of people here give their time to help others. Nobody pays them for it.
text.fr: Des millions de personnes ici donnent de leur temps pour aider les autres. Personne ne les paie pour cela.

source.quote: Millions of volunteers freely donate their time to help others without pay

verification.evidence: Millions of volunteers freely donate their time to help others without pay

text.en: Come with me. We stop four times on the way down to the water, and I have something to tell you at each one.
text.fr: Venez avec moi. On fait quatre haltes en descendant vers l'eau, et j'ai quelque chose à vous dire à chacune.

prompt.en: Answer 4 questions about the responsibilities that come with your rights
prompt.fr: Répondez à 4 questions sur les responsabilités qui accompagnent vos droits

text.en: Stand still a moment. This is a good spot to talk about what the country asks of you.
text.fr: Arrêtez-vous un instant. C'est un bon endroit pour parler de ce que le pays vous demande.

text.en: Voting is a right here. It is also a duty: you are asked to vote in federal elections, in provincial or territorial ones, and in the local ones too.
text.fr: Voter est un droit ici. C'est aussi un devoir : on vous demande de voter aux élections fédérales, aux élections provinciales ou territoriales, et aussi aux élections municipales.

source.quote: Voting in elections — The right to vote comes with a responsibility to vote in federal, provincial or territorial and local elections.

verification.evidence: In Canada, rights come with responsibilities. These include: … Voting in elections — The right to vote comes with a responsibility to vote in federal, provincial or territorial and local elections.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about where our rights and freedoms come from
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur l'origine de nos droits et libertés

text.en: A market is a good place to see the next one at work.
text.fr: Un marché est un bon endroit pour voir la suite à l'œuvre.

text.en: Obeying the law is one of the things citizenship asks of you. People and governments alike are held to the law itself, and not to anyone's say-so. No person and no group stands above it.
text.fr: Respecter la loi fait partie de ce que la citoyenneté vous demande. Les personnes comme les gouvernements sont tenus par la loi elle-même, et non par le bon vouloir de quelqu'un. Aucune personne ni aucun groupe n'est au-dessus d'elle.

source.quote: Obeying the law — One of Canada’s founding principles is the rule of law. Individuals and governments are regulated by laws and not by arbitrary actions. No person or group is above the law.

verification.evidence: In Canada, rights come with responsibilities. These include: Obeying the law — One of Canada’s founding principles is the rule of law. Individuals and governments are regulated by laws and not by arbitrary actions. No person or group is above the law. … The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.

prompt.en: Answer 2 questions about obeying the law and looking after your family
prompt.fr: Répondez à 2 questions sur le respect de la loi et sur le soin de sa famille

text.en: This is the bottom of the walk. What I want to tell you here is about you, not about the building.
text.fr: C'est ici que se termine la descente. Ce que je veux vous dire ici parle de vous, pas du bâtiment.

text.en: The Charter treats many cultures living together as a basic part of what Canada is. People here are asked to respect that mix and to live at peace inside it.
text.fr: La Charte présente la coexistence de nombreuses cultures comme un trait fondamental de ce qu'est le Canada. On demande aux gens d'ici de respecter cette diversité et d'y vivre en paix.

source.quote: Multiculturalism — A fundamental characteristic of the Canadian heritage and identity. Canadians celebrate the gift of one another’s presence and work hard to respect pluralism and live in harmony.

verification.evidence: The Charter attempts to summarize fundamental freedoms while also setting out additional rights. The most important of these include: … Multiculturalism — A fundamental characteristic of the Canadian heritage and identity. Canadians celebrate the gift of one another’s presence and work hard to respect pluralism and live in harmony.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about the Charter and your rights
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur la Charte et vos droits

prompt.en: Go on to the harbour tug

text.en: One last stop, right at the water. Then I am done talking.
text.fr: Une dernière halte, tout près de l'eau. Ensuite, j'aurai fini de parler.

text.en: There is work of this kind open to you as well. You can serve in the Coast Guard, or in a police force or a fire department where you live.
text.fr: Ce genre de travail vous est aussi ouvert. Vous pouvez servir dans la Garde côtière, ou dans un service de police ou de pompiers de votre localité.

source.quote: You may also serve in the Coast Guard or emergency services in your community such as a police force or fire department.

verification.evidence: Defending Canada … You may also serve in the Coast Guard or emergency services in your community such as a police force or fire department. By helping to protect your community, you follow in the footsteps of Canadians before you who made sacrifices in the service of our country.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about serving your community
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur le service à la collectivité
